20261118-math-g01.title: Ọnụọgụgụ na ọrụ, ụdị
20261118-math-g01.goal: Tinye ụkpụrụ nke Ọnụọgụgụ na ọrụ, ụdị iji dozie nsogbu nnyocha.
20261118-math-g01.material: [E1 Nnyocha Mgbakọ na Mwepụ] Ajụjụ nnyocha gbasara Ọnụọgụgụ na ọrụ, ụdị. Ọnụọgụ eke abụọ $A$ na $B$ na-emezu $A + 2B = 24$. Mgbe $A$ nwetara uru kachasị elu, gịnị bụ uru $B$?
20261118-math-g01.s.s1.prompt: [E1 Nnyocha Mgbakọ na Mwepụ] Ajụjụ nnyocha gbasara Ọnụọgụgụ na ọrụ, ụdị. Ọnụọgụ eke abụọ $A$ na $B$ na-emezu $A + 2B = 24$. Mgbe $A$ nwetara uru kachasị elu, gịnị bụ uru $B$?
20261118-math-g01.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Hazigharịa usoro na-enye $A = 24 - 2B$.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Ebe $A, B \ge 1$ bụ ọnụọgụ eke, $2B$ ga-abụ nke kacha nta ka $A$ wee buru ibu.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ọnụọgụ eke kacha nta bụ $B = 1$.
Nzọụkwụ 4: N'oge a, $A = 24 - 2(1) = 22$ (kacha elu), ya mere $B = 1$.
20261118-math-g01.s.s1.hint.0: Uru ọnụọgụ eke kacha nta maka $B$ bụ $1$.
20261118-math-g01.s.s1.hint.1: Ebe ọ bụ na $A = 24 - 2B$, $A$ na-ebuwanye ibu mgbe $B$ dị ntakịrị.

20261119-math-g01-2.title: Ọnụọgụgụ na ọrụ, ụdị
20261119-math-g01-2.goal: Tinye ụkpụrụ nke Ọnụọgụgụ na ọrụ, ụdị iji dozie nsogbu nnyocha.
20261119-math-g01-2.material: [E1 Nnyocha Mgbakọ na Mwepụ (Dị Elu)] Nsogbu nnyocha dị mgbagwoju anya site na iji Ọnụọgụgụ na ọrụ, ụdị. Mkpokọta ọnụọgụ eke atọ na-esochi bụ $3S$, ngwaahịa nke kacha nta na nke kacha ukwuu gbakwunyere $1$ hà ka $T^2$. Mgbe $S = 15$, olee nke kacha ukwuu n'ime ha atọ?
20261119-math-g01-2.s.s1.prompt: [E1 Nnyocha Mgbakọ na Mwepụ (Dị Elu)] Nsogbu nnyocha dị mgbagwoju anya site na iji Ọnụọgụgụ na ọrụ, ụdị. Mkpokọta ọnụọgụ eke atọ na-esochi bụ $3S$, ngwaahịa nke kacha nta na nke kacha ukwuu gbakwunyere $1$ hà ka $T^2$. Mgbe $S = 15$, olee nke kacha ukwuu n'ime ha atọ?
20261119-math-g01-2.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Ịtụle ọnụọgụ dị ka $n-1, n, n+1$, mkpokọta bụ $3n = 3S \Rightarrow n = S = 15$.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Ọnụọgụ atọ ahụ bụ $14, 15, 16$.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Nke kacha ukwuu bụ $16$.
Nzọụkwụ 4: Nkwenye: $(14 \times 16) + 1 = 224 + 1 = 225 = 15^2$.
20261119-math-g01-2.s.s1.hint.0: Ịtụle ọnụọgụ na-esochi dị ka $n-1, n, n+1$ na-enye mkpokọta $3n$.

Mkpokọta ọnụọgụ eke atọ na-esochi bụ $3S$, ngwaahịa nke kacha nta na nke kacha ukwuu gbakwunyere $1$ hà ka $T^2$. Mgbe $S = 15$, olee nke kacha ukwuu n'ime ha atọ?

20261125-math-g01-1.s.s1.prompt: [E1 Nnyocha Mgbakọ na Mwepụ] Ajụjụ nnyocha gbasara Ọnụọgụgụ na ọrụ, ụdị. Ọnụọgụ eke abụọ $A$ na $B$ na-emezu $A + 2B = 24$. Mgbe $A$ nwetara uru kachasị elu, gịnị bụ uru $B$?
20261125-math-g01-1.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Hazigharịa usoro na-enye $A = 24 - 2B$.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Ebe $A, B \ge 1$ bụ ọnụọgụ eke, $2B$ ga-abụ nke kacha nta ka $A$ wee buru ibu.

Nzọụkwụ 4: N'oge a, $A = 24 - 2(1) = 22$ (kacha elu), ya mere $B = 1$.
